mainText: Hello, Verona! At 3 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We have clear skies at Verona Community Park with a temperature of 73 degrees, but be aware that the air quality index is 57.

In city news, the finance department has published the proposed 2027 budget and is preparing residents for property tax bills, which will be mailed by December 15. Additionally, the Plan Commission is set to review several development proposals on November 4th, including plans for Ardent Glen and new site maps for property on Milky Way.

It is a busy week for local events! Today, you can join Yoga at Insight Wellness, enjoy the Thursday night festivities at ART House 360, or participate in Hop Haus Trivia at 6:30 PM. Looking ahead, catch live music at Bailey's Run and Wisconsin Brewing Company tomorrow, and don't forget the Dane County Farmer's Market this Saturday.

In police news, on October 15, the Verona Police Department arrested a school bus driver for O W I following reports of dangerous driving while students were on board. Fortunately, no injuries were reported, and the department is continuing to investigate the incident.
Today at Culver's, enjoy the Flavor of the Day, Dark Chocolate PB Crunch. The restaurant is currently open and will remain open until 10 PM tonight, so there is plenty of time to stop by for a treat.
